summary: The document is a 2026 Louisiana Department of Insurance Homeowners Statistical Plan establishing quarterly homeowners statistical reporting obligations, fixed-width record reporting, premium/exposure reporting rules, and loss reporting rules. It defines a 45-day quarterly reporting deadline, references a designated statistical agent, and specifies several field/code requirements including parish FIPS code, deductible type codes, mitigation code, cause of loss code, disposition code, and catastrophe serial number handling.

proposed_nodes.name: Louisiana Homeowners Statistical Plan
proposed_nodes.description: Louisiana homeowners statistical reporting plan effective January 1, 2026.
proposed_nodes.title: Homeowners Statistical Plan

proposed_nodes.name: LA_HOMEOWNERS_2026
proposed_nodes.description: 2026 edition of the Louisiana Homeowners Statistical Plan.

proposed_nodes.name: Louisiana Department of Insurance
proposed_nodes.description: Regulatory agency named in the plan header.

proposed_nodes.name: Designated Statistical Agent
proposed_nodes.description: The statistical agent to which insurers must report and which assigns catastrophe serial numbers; the agent is not named in the excerpt.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule 1 — Scope and Reporting Obligation
proposed_nodes.description: Requires every insurer writing homeowners insurance in Louisiana to report each policy transaction to the designated statistical agent within 45 days after the close of the calendar quarter in which it occurred.
proposed_nodes.title: Scope and Reporting Obligation
proposed_nodes.heading: Scope and Reporting Obligation

proposed_nodes.name: Rule 2 — Fixed-Width Records and NAIC Company Code
proposed_nodes.description: Requires records to be reported in the fixed-width format prescribed in Section 3 and to carry the insurer's five-digit NAIC company code.
proposed_nodes.title: Fixed-Width Records and NAIC Company Code
proposed_nodes.heading: Scope and Reporting Obligation

proposed_nodes.name: Rule 3 — Parish Code
proposed_nodes.description: Requires the parish code to be the three-digit FIPS code of the parish where the insured dwelling is located as of the transaction effective date.
proposed_nodes.title: Parish Code
proposed_nodes.heading: Scope and Reporting Obligation

proposed_nodes.name: Rule 4 — Written Premium Reporting
proposed_nodes.description: Requires written premium to be reported in whole dollars and return premiums as negative amounts using the same transaction code as the original entry.
proposed_nodes.title: Written Premium Reporting
proposed_nodes.heading: Premium and Exposure Reporting

proposed_nodes.name: Rule 5 — Amount of Insurance Reporting for Coverage A
proposed_nodes.description: Requires amount of insurance to be reported in whole thousands of dollars, rounded to the nearest thousand, for Coverage A on dwelling forms.
proposed_nodes.title: Amount of Insurance Reporting for Coverage A
proposed_nodes.heading: Premium and Exposure Reporting

proposed_nodes.name: Rule 6 — Hurricane Deductible Type Codes
proposed_nodes.description: Requires hurricane deductibles expressed as a percentage of Coverage A limit to use deductible type code 3 and flat-dollar hurricane deductibles to use deductible type code 2.
proposed_nodes.title: Hurricane Deductible Type Codes
proposed_nodes.heading: Premium and Exposure Reporting

proposed_nodes.name: Rule 7 — Louisiana Fortify Home Mitigation Credits
proposed_nodes.description: Requires premium credits granted under the Louisiana Fortify Home mitigation program to be reported with the mitigation code from the Section 4 code table.
proposed_nodes.title: Louisiana Fortify Home Mitigation Credits
proposed_nodes.heading: Premium and Exposure Reporting

proposed_nodes.name: Rule 8 — Paid Loss Reporting
proposed_nodes.description: Requires each paid loss to be reported with the cause of loss code, accident date, and amount paid during the reporting quarter, excluding loss adjustment expense.
proposed_nodes.title: Paid Loss Reporting
proposed_nodes.heading: Loss Reporting

proposed_nodes.name: Rule 9 — Claims Closed Without Payment
proposed_nodes.description: Requires claims closed without payment to be reported once in the quarter of closure with a paid amount of zero and disposition code C.
proposed_nodes.title: Claims Closed Without Payment
proposed_nodes.heading: Loss Reporting

proposed_nodes.name: Rule 10 — Catastrophe Serial Number Reporting
proposed_nodes.description: Requires catastrophe losses to carry the catastrophe serial number assigned by the statistical agent and non-catastrophe losses to report a serial number of zero.
proposed_nodes.title: Catastrophe Serial Number Reporting
proposed_nodes.heading: Loss Reporting

proposed_nodes.name: Louisiana Homeowners Quarterly Statistical Report
proposed_nodes.description: Quarterly homeowners statistical report covering policy transactions and related statistical records, due 45 days after calendar-quarter close.

proposed_nodes.name: Louisiana Homeowners Fixed-Width Record Layout
proposed_nodes.description: Fixed-width record format required for reported records; the detailed layout is referenced as prescribed elsewhere in the plan.

proposed_nodes.name: NAIC Company Code
proposed_nodes.description: Insurer's five-digit NAIC company code carried on each record.

proposed_nodes.name: Parish Code
proposed_nodes.description: Three-digit FIPS code of the parish in which the insured dwelling is located as of the transaction effective date.
proposed_nodes.notes: Use parish where insured dwelling is located as of transaction effective date.

proposed_nodes.name: Written Premium
proposed_nodes.description: Written premium reported in whole dollars; return premiums reported as negative amounts with the same transaction code as the original entry.
proposed_nodes.format: whole dollars; negative amount for return premiums
proposed_nodes.notes: Return premiums carry the same transaction code as the original entry.

proposed_nodes.name: Amount of Insurance
proposed_nodes.description: Amount of insurance reported in whole thousands of dollars, rounded to nearest thousand, for Coverage A on dwelling forms.
proposed_nodes.format: whole thousands of dollars, rounded to nearest thousand
proposed_nodes.notes: Applies to Coverage A on dwelling forms.

proposed_nodes.name: Deductible Type Code
proposed_nodes.description: Code identifying the deductible type for hurricane deductibles.
proposed_nodes.notes: Percentage hurricane deductible uses code 3; flat-dollar hurricane deductible uses code 2.

proposed_nodes.name: Mitigation Code
proposed_nodes.description: Mitigation code from the Section 4 code table used for Louisiana Fortify Home mitigation premium credits.
proposed_nodes.notes: Used when premium credits are granted under the Louisiana Fortify Home mitigation program.

proposed_nodes.name: Cause of Loss Code
proposed_nodes.description: Cause of loss code from Section 4 required for each paid loss.

proposed_nodes.name: Accident Date
proposed_nodes.description: Accident date required for each paid loss.

proposed_nodes.name: Paid Amount
proposed_nodes.description: Amount paid during the reporting quarter for each paid loss; loss adjustment expense is excluded. Claims closed without payment use paid amount zero.
proposed_nodes.format: amount paid during reporting quarter; zero for claims closed without payment
proposed_nodes.notes: Loss adjustment expense is excluded from reported amounts.

proposed_nodes.name: Disposition Code
proposed_nodes.description: Disposition code used for claims closed without payment; code C is required in that circumstance.
proposed_nodes.notes: Claims closed without payment use disposition code C.

proposed_nodes.name: Catastrophe Serial Number
proposed_nodes.description: Catastrophe losses carry the catastrophe serial number assigned by the statistical agent; non-catastrophe losses report serial number zero.
proposed_nodes.format: statistical-agent assigned serial number; zero for non-catastrophe losses

proposed_nodes.name: Coverage A — Dwelling
proposed_nodes.description: Coverage A on dwelling forms, referenced for amount of insurance and hurricane deductible reporting.

proposed_nodes.name: Deductible Type
proposed_nodes.description: Enumeration of deductible type codes used for hurricane deductibles.

proposed_nodes.name: Deductible Type Code 3 — Percentage Hurricane Deductible
proposed_nodes.description: Deductible type code for a hurricane deductible expressed as a percentage of the Coverage A limit.
proposed_nodes.notes: For a hurricane deductible expressed as a percentage of the Coverage A limit.

proposed_nodes.name: Deductible Type Code 2 — Flat-Dollar Hurricane Deductible
proposed_nodes.description: Deductible type code for a flat-dollar hurricane deductible.

proposed_nodes.name: Mitigation
proposed_nodes.description: Code table for mitigation codes, including codes used for Louisiana Fortify Home mitigation program premium credits; individual code values are in Section 4, not included in this excerpt.
proposed_nodes.notes: Referenced as the code table in Section 4.

proposed_nodes.name: Cause of Loss
proposed_nodes.description: Cause of loss code list referenced for paid loss reporting; individual code values are in Section 4, not included in this excerpt.

proposed_nodes.name: Disposition
proposed_nodes.description: Disposition code list used for claim disposition reporting.

proposed_nodes.name: Disposition Code C — Closed Without Payment
proposed_nodes.description: Disposition code required for claims closed without payment.
proposed_nodes.notes: Used when a claim is closed without payment and reported with paid amount zero.
